## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the commit history is reviewable.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally.
- [ ] I ran `npm run smoke:package` for CLI, MCP, initialization, packaging, or platform changes.
- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented.
- [ ] Windows, Linux, and macOS behavior remains portable.
- [ ] No secrets, telemetry, or implicit network calls were introduced.
- [ ] I read and followed `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
